query_normalized: evaluating the use of llms for automated documentation generation from code commits computer science
rationale: The paper focuses on a general framework for evaluating LLM-generated text quality using pairwise comparisons and Elo ratings, which does not address the specific mechanism of generating documentation from code commits or the domain of software engineering documentation.
